# Config keys (leaf paths of config.Config's yaml surface) that no reference document names.
# Read by TestEveryConfigKeyIsDocumented (config_leaves_documented_test.go).
# This list only shrinks. Never add a line: document the key in docs/CONFIGURATION.md.
# A line whose key is documented now, or is no longer a key, fails the test: delete it.
# A key that stays is one an operator never sets. Its line is `<key> <reason>`; a line
# without a reason fails the test.
client.auth.api_key legacy pre-ADR-108 CLI connection setting: the server ignores it (it only feeds the secrets-must-differ check in ConfiguredSecretValues); the current CLI keeps its own credential store
client.auth.type legacy pre-ADR-108 CLI connection setting: nothing in the server or the current CLI reads it
client.endpoint legacy pre-ADR-108 CLI connection setting: the server ignores it; `keyorix login` reads the old CLI's cli.yaml through its own struct (cli/internal/migrate) to offer the URL again
client.timeout legacy pre-ADR-108 CLI connection setting: nothing in the server or the current CLI reads it
